title: Why Engineer Is the Wrong Word for What's Coming
description:
We're heading toward a world where one person isn't managing code — they're managing an entire company of agents, each running a function. You're not the CEO anymore. You're the owner, and the CEO is an agent.

We discussed:
◼ Why the ratio of engineers to output is about to break — one person could soon run what used to take an entire team.
◼ Why "engineer" is the wrong word for what this role becomes — it's closer to a manager, or something bigger.
◼ Why the role isn't even CEO anymore — a CEO still operates. This is more like ownership.
◼ What it looks like when you're not running the company, you're in conversation with the agent who is — the agent acting as CEO, VP of marketing, and head of engineering all at once.
◼ Why human agency is the one thing that doesn't get automated away — and why that's the real differentiator going forward.

Inflection Point is a long-form conversation podcast featuring enterprise CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, heads of AI, founders, and board members on what it actually took to ship AI in production, how threat landscapes shift when AI enters the stack, and what the next chapter of Digital Intelligence looks like from the seat of the people building it. Hosted by Moudy Elbayadi, Ph.D., Chief AI & Innovation Officer at EVOTEK. No vendor pitch, no scripted questions — real conversations with the leaders who built it.
